guidedSteps.title: Check what loads
steps: Open a new Claude Code session in the repo and run `/context`. Memory files should list `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` and the always-on rules from `.claude/rules`.
Run `/skills`. Each repo skill should appear once.
Open a file that matches a path-scoped rule; that rule should load then, not at launch.

guidedSteps.title: Cloud sessions
steps: Claude Code cloud sessions load the repo's `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules` and `.claude/skills`, but not plugins. The migrated setup lives in repo files, so it works there; this plugin itself is only needed to migrate.

guidedSteps.title: Copy personal User Rules by hand
steps: Cursor Settings → Rules → User Rules live in Cursor, not in the repo, so they were not migrated.
Copy the ones you want in Claude Code into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (all your projects) or this repo's `CLAUDE.md` (this project only).

guidedSteps.title: Third-party configs toggle
steps: Cursor Settings → "Include third-party Plugins, Skills, and other configs" decides whether Cursor also reads Claude Code config such as `.claude/skills`.
Either setting works here: `.claude/skills` is an exact copy of `.agents/skills`, and Cursor shows a skill found in both once.

Cursor does not merge user-level folders: a skill in both `~/.agents/skills` and `~/.cursor/skills-cursor` shows twice. `~/.cursor/skills-cursor` is managed by Cursor; remove the copy in `~/.agents/skills` if you did not put it there on purpose.
